admissible_output_retention_ceiling.interpretation: Admission ceilings, not expected required storage. Full outputs retained; no scientific output retirement or reduced cohort.

array_payload_bounds.note: Query rows partition supported native time bins, so one complete panel is bounded by the full firing geometry. This is a shape upper bound, not authenticated query counts.

clocks.qualification: Prospective finite upper choices; not measured runtime, speed or feasibility. No scientific run authorized. WORK is a cooperative cutoff for bounded IO; original alarms and final post-cleanup checks bound acceptance.

managed_accounting_details.generated_tree_blocks: Reserve each possible file at18*4096 overhead; pre-copy views also charge each file. Credits only after exact closed-tree proof and durable retirement. Unused private upper reservations settle to verified exact bytes plus conservative block bounds after closure, never reducing cumulative IO.
managed_accounting_details.metadata_upper: 3GiB holds213*8MiB journals +71reports/journals +4programs +original phase receipts/requests/bindings/source snapshots with bounded per-file block overhead. Actual total remains gated.
managed_accounting_details.scope: Managed source/artifact reads and logical output reservations only; not kernel/cache/runtime total IO or memory measurements. Reference fits are unqualified.

memory_limit_notes: 16GiB host/producer and2GiB observer are prospective ceilings; largest known single native raster1,141,359,120B does not bound all concurrent arrays, BLAS workspaces, expanded JSON or whole-process RSS. No measured feasibility claim.

original_artifact_contract.no_domain_narrowing: Retain original NPZ bytes; no float conversion, rounding or optional-support filter.

retained_admission.formula: full3 native output caps +2 candidate panel caps +70 four-baseline file caps + full prepared pool + one staged public/private packet + one runtime view + complete original private targets/bindings +3GiB metadata +256MiB allocation +16MiB observer

sequential_policy: Prepare the complete full-session pool once. Native views retire after exact natural closure. Stage one prospective episode once; run fresh A, B and operator phases on exactly that case, retain target/case/baseline/predictions, then durably retire only its owned temporary training/query files and views. No cross-case data or prediction feedback.
